mass_distribution: Normal(mean=1, sigma=0.05), constant multiplier per flight
cd_distribution: Normal(mean=1, sigma=0.02), constant multiplier per flight
wind: Mean 10 mph (4.4704 m/s), direction 90 degrees, 10% turbulence; fixed native realization across runs
native_feature: Simulation.simulate with enabled EnsembleSettings; no custom perturbation listener
criterion: Every one of 30 paired flights has main deployment before ground contact and vertical impact speed within +/-5% of its own apogee+1s baseline.
altitude_reference: Height above flat ground at URRG launch-pad elevation; no DEM correction
deployment_model: Native instantaneous full CdA; no canopy inflation or opening-load failure model
refinement_method: Descending 0.1-second delay grid below the earliest unchuted ground-contact time; no monotonicity assumption for the speed-error criterion
status: Superseded at user request by the deployment-altitude study; completed individual delay results retained.
